name: Kaly (Czechia)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and yellow, with a fleur-de-lis and a cross-shaped charge counterchanged over the division.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 22 January 2001 (decision No. 79) and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
